title: FaultDx DEKG Validation Policy
description: Defines whether a DEKG full-document or evidence-residual package is accepted as evidence, held for review, or rejected. It does not approve TPDX publication, graph-node promotion, or runtime adoption.

rejection_conditions: missing required package or record provenance
content kind is raw image or unapproved provider output
blocked field name or value marker is present
duplicate composite identity has non-equivalent content
ingestion_mode is neither full_document nor evidence_residual
full_document declares TPDX extraction or excluded anchors
evidence_residual lacks a table-only partition decision, TPDX extraction refs, consumption state, or excluded table anchors
evidence_residual emits an anchor listed as excluded for TPDX
DEKG evidence overlaps a TPDX fact
co-source TPDX extraction is presented as independent corroboration
record claims reviewed or confirmed diagnosis
candidate_review_conditions: support-object property shape is not yet frozen
source alias collides with another governed source
anchor is syntactically present but cannot be independently resolved
content requires domain review for safe exposure

breaking_changes: published_graph becomes accepted_evidence to avoid implying TPDX publication.
DocumentAsset is replaced by non-node DEKGEvidenceRecord.
Full-document ingestion is the default; residual mode is conditional on table extraction for TPDX.
Runtime constants cannot load this proposal without an explicit adapter and consumer review.
migration: Do not bind this proposal to runtime before freeze approval. Inventory any deployed legacy consumer separately because the tracked Route B v2 pair is deleted in the current worktree.
Add producer validation for release, lineage, source version, and co-source fields.
Add a migration adapter that emits DEKGEvidenceRecord with stable evidence_id and explicit ingestion mode from approved legacy payloads.
Run old/new contract validation on identical synthetic and approved serving-safe packages.
Bind runtime only after affected-consumer approval.
compatibility.rollback: Do not bind this proposal before freeze approval. If consumer review fails, reject the new package and return the proposal for revision; this task does not restore deleted legacy contracts.
